status: provisional thresholds; recalibrate from recorded deferrals and outcomes
threshold_basis: TypeSafe confidence guidance routes answers below a 0.5 floor away from automatic action. Not calibrated on this router's outcomes.
action: Questions below the threshold are held. One fresh Claude decision session receives the same model/state with only the held questions and returns the same typed answer fields. Jev answers at or above the threshold are used unchanged.
claude_session: Existing adaptive provider Claude decision path: claude --print --no-session-persistence with the typed JSON schema and the manifest worker profile.
failure: A failed or uncertain Claude deferral stops the decision like any provider failure. The low-confidence Jev answer is never used as a silent fallback.
recorded: Jev answer with probabilities and confidence
